messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] HIGH: spike in model-routing errors for alias=search-embed-v2 in us-east-1. 5xx/400-type-mismatch on /v1/embeddings.
ci-release-bot: automated alias update completed at 2026-03-15T11:11:37Z; old_variant=embed-x-quant new_variant=chat-x-hot
emma: I'm on-call, investigating. tagging @raj @sam for routing and runtime
raj: looking at routing table change; saw alias flip event from release pipeline
sam: clients are hitting type mismatch: chat model rejects embedding request -> 400 incompatible_input_type
maria: CS reports ACME and BetaBank search pipelines are failing since ~11:13 UTC
lee: release pipeline logs show actor=ci-release-bot triggered global alias swap during deployment
emma: mitigation: revert alias to embed-x-quant and flush routing caches. who can run the revert in us-east?
jordan: I will run the revert: rwctl routes set --alias search-embed-v2 --variant embed-x-quant --force --region us-east-1
opsbot: command accepted from jordan at 2026-03-15T11:19:05Z; applying override
sam: note: fallback policy allowed cross-interface fallback (chat fallback for embeds) when variant unavailable. that's a policy misconfiguration
maria: impact summary: ~842 failed embeddings in last 10m; errors predominantly 400-type-mismatch. affected: ACME, BetaBank, internal indexers
cs-lead: notifying customer oncall contacts and opening CS tickets. CS-9987 created for BetaBank
raj: flushing routing cache for alias now: rwctl cache flush --scope routing --alias search-embed-v2
opsbot: cache flush initiated by raj at 2026-03-15T11:20:12Z; propagate ~30-120s
lee: after revert+flush, us-east error rate dropped from ~18% to ~3% within 45s. eu-west still elevated due to replication lag
emma: request smoke tests for embeddings in both regions
sam: us-east smoke -> 200 OK, embedding vector returned
jordan: forcing replication to eu-west: rwctl replication force --alias search-embed-v2 --regions eu-west-1
opsbot: replication queued by jordan at 2026-03-15T11:24:30Z; ETA ~45s
maria: customers notified: rolling back mis-routed alias; mitigation in progress; no data leakage observed
cs-lead: BetaBank requested postmortem; assigned to PM and eng leads
raj: root cause: release-service allowed alias swaps with no interface compatibility check; routing cache not fully invalidated on alias change
lee: created infra tickets INF-452 (compatibility checks), INF-453 (ensure cache invalidation)
sam: short-term: add release-time safety check blocking alias swaps if interface mismatch detected; add dark-traffic canary stage
emma: marking incident P0 until EU stabilizes. assigning follow-ups to release and routing owners
opsbot: monitoring shows us-east failures down to 1.2%, eu-west down to 2.7% after replication
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-99281 acknowledged by emma (oncall); status: mitigation in progress
maria: confirming no cross-tenant data exposure; failed requests only, no successful chat responses to embedding clients
emma: next steps: draft postmortem, mandatory preflight compatibility check, automatic cache flush on alias change, add interface-type alerting
raj: adding runbook entry: on alias change, auto cache flush and enqueue cross-region replication
lee: adding dashboard alert for sudden spike in input-type mismatches for embeddings vs chat
jordan: assigning follow-ups -> raj (routing validation), lee (release-service patch), sam (alerts)
opsbot: incident resolved: services stable and error rates back to baseline at 2026-03-15T11:42:50Z. Please attach postmortem link when ready
emma: thanks team. drafting incident summary and postmortem owners. closing PD after follow-up
